visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A cartoon mascot with large black eyes and white skin appears on a plain white background, looking surprised with sweat drops on its forehead. Above it, large yellow text with black outlines is visible. The mascot's mouth is a small oval, and its body is a simple white silhouette. (2) A street corner during the day features an inflatable Santa Claus in a red suit and green bag, positioned as if climbing a metal scaffolding on the side of a building. Several people on scooters pass through the intersection under a traffic light. The buildings are brick-faced with various colorful signs. (3) The scene shifts back to the cartoon mascot, now in a tighter close-up, emphasizing its wide-eyed, shocked expression and the blue-tinged forehead indicating worry or confusion. The background remains stark white, and the yellow text persists at the top of the frame. (4) Outside a convenience store, another inflatable Santa is seen climbing a glass window above stacks of large yellow water jugs. The Santa wears the iconic red suit with white trim. The store interior is brightly lit, showing shelves of merchandise through the glass. (5) The cartoon mascot reappears, maintaining the same stunned facial expression with mouth slightly agape. The lighting on the character is flat, and its simple black outlines are crisp against the white background. The text overlay remains unchanged at the top. (6) A nighttime shot reveals a Santa decoration hanging from the side of a building near a neon sign for a toy store. The building has a balcony with white railings and parked scooters below. The street is illuminated by various shop signs and artificial street lights. (7) Final nighttime scene shows a large inflatable Santa scaling a modern building with colorful panels. A motorcyclist passes by in the foreground. The gate to the premises is visible, and the overall atmosphere is typical of a bustling urban night environment.
